caption: The drawing depicts a riverside or lakeside scene with several boats on the water. In the foreground on the left, there are palm trees and three people working in a garden or field of leafy plants, with two carrying baskets and another bending over. The middle ground shows a large paddle steamer with a blue flag and red accents, and a smaller rowboat with two figures near the shore. Further back, there are three more boats on the water, all with red coloring. On the right side, a building with a red roof is positioned among large, leafy trees draped with hanging moss. In the background, mountains or large hills rise beyond the water, under a partly cloudy sky. The color palette consists primarily of muted browns, greens, blues, and reds, giving the entire composition a washed, textured appearance.
title: Printed Cotton
